title: Standard parity circuit tail
statement: For a natural number $r$, define the circuit tail $T_{r,q,g}$ for each natural number $q$ and each gate $g\in\{\mathsf{AND},\mathsf{OR}\}$ recursively as follows. At level $q=0$, $T_{r,0,g}$ is the singleton output layer whose incoming wires are selected by the parity product rule for $g$. At level $q+1$, $T_{r,q+1,g}$ consists of the next layer of parity nodes followed by $T_{r,q,g^*}$, where $g^*$ interchanges AND and OR.
